results.rationale: The two red toy vehicles and wooden tabletop remain recognizable, but both vehicles shift slightly within the framing. Sand still fills the upper bulb and visibly falls through the neck, whereas completion requires an empty upper chamber. Instruction failure makes knowledge invalid.
